verdict.rationale: Ardent's own documented automation is narrow: you can configure SQL that runs automatically on every new branch created from a connector. This is an event-triggered hook, not a recurring schedule or a general background-automation system. Per-PR branch automation depends on the user's own CI harness or scripts running the CLI, which is host-platform and user-side and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a scheduled or recurring automation capability, a general background job or trigger system owned by Ardent, documentation of configuring and monitoring such automations, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: you can run SQL on every new branch from this connector after it is created.
